name: libxsmm-panel32-fmopa-order-0213
hypothesis: Change only the active panel32 FMOPA order to ZA0, ZA2, ZA1, ZA3. This groups operations using the same B vector and tests instruction scheduling; benefit is unverified. Each tile retains its operands, predicates and K=0..511 FP32 update order. This change is absent from the supplied measured history. Loads, pointer advances, ABI, SME transitions, stack, timed packing/allocation, stores, fallback and BSD notices remain unchanged. No tools or tests were run. Compilation, all 48 public cases at tolerance 0.002, ten validation reports, ten alternating fresh imported controls under unchanged power settings, the fixed promotion gate and holdout validation remain required.
